WITH platform_totals AS (
    SELECT r.region_name, p.platform_name, SUM(rs.num_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales AS rs
    JOIN region AS r ON r.id = rs.region_id
    JOIN game_platform AS gp ON gp.id = rs.game_platform_id
    JOIN platform AS p ON p.id = gp.platform_id
    GROUP BY r.region_name, p.platform_name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT region_name, platform_name,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM platform_totals
)
SELECT region_name, platform_name
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_name, platform_name;
